## Does it survive the artboard rule

An artboard is a real HTML file on disk. Explain how this works without making an artboard mean
anything else, and without introducing a second representation of the same screen.

## Is it v1 or later

v1 is one thing: one sentence in the agent produces an artboard, and the agent improves it once
after looking at its own screenshot. Say plainly whether this is on that path or after it.
Proposals for later are useful and will be recorded rather than built early.

## Which model is required

If the proposal only works with a particular model's capabilities, say so. Anything that depends
on a specific vendor's model is the opposite of what this tool is for.
